# Benchmark lifecycle engineering fixture

This fixture exists only to test M2.1 schemas, hashing, answer isolation, reverse variants, build,
validation, and write-once freeze mechanics. It is non-scientific, not promotable, and prohibited
from outcome, selection, retention, `selection_probe_v1`, and `v1_core` namespaces.

The prompts are synthetic exact-code checks. They contain no experimental task, target domain,
published probe, or anticipated treatment/evaluation content.
